name: Aalee Assist
author: Aalee

sections.description:
Aalee Assist puts a smart AI chat widget on your WordPress site in under 2 minutes.

Your assistant learns from your business content, answers visitor questions instantly, captures leads automatically, and hands off to a human agent when needed — all managed from one powerful dashboard.

Why businesses choose Aalee Assist:

  • Zero coding — install, paste your Assistant ID, done
  • Instant answers — AI trained on your own knowledge base
  • Automatic lead capture — never miss a potential customer
  • Human handoff — escalate complex queries to your team anytime
  • Works on every page automatically — no per-page setup
  • Async script — zero impact on your page speed
  • Full conversation history inside your Aalee dashboard
  • Lightweight — one small script is all it takes

How it works:

  1. Create an AI assistant at assist.aalee.ai
  2. Train it with your website content, FAQs, or documents
  3. Install this plugin, paste your Assistant ID, and go live
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Aalee Assist”
  4. Click Install Now → Activate
  5. You will be redirected to the settings page automatically
  6. Paste your Assistant ID from your Aalee Assist dashboard
  7. Click Save & Activate — your chat widget is now live on every page

Where to find your Assistant ID:

  1. Log in at assist.aalee.ai
  2. Go to Assistants
  3. Select your assistant
  4. Copy the Assistant ID and paste it in the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. Install the plugin, paste your Assistant ID, and save. That is everything.

Where do I find my Assistant ID?

Log in to assist.aalee.ai, go to Assistants, select your assistant, and copy the Assistant ID shown there.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The widget script loads asynchronously — it never blocks your page from loading and has zero impact on your page speed.

Does the widget appear on all pages?

Yes. Once activated, the chat widget appears automatically on every page of your WordPress site.

Can I hand off chats to a human agent?

Yes. Aalee Assist supports human handoff. Your team can take over any conversation directly from the Aalee dashboard.

What happens if I close the setup popup?

You can always go to Settings → Aalee Assist to configure your Assistant ID at any time.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All input is sanitized and escaped following WordPress security standards.
